history.body: Hi, I’m looking at Pearl Residences because we’re hoping to buy somewhere around Seberang Jaya. Could you tell me what the 3-bedroom units are like and roughly what the monthly costs would be?

The standard Type A is 900 sq.ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The living, dining and kitchen areas are open-plan, and the layout avoids a long internal corridor and includes some storage. Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq.ft., inclusive of sinking fund; selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use and aren’t included in that fee. I’m confirming the monthly maintenance total for this unit and the current indicative price so I don’t misquote the overall cost. Any loan instalment would also depend on your financing. If the layout sounds suitable, I’d be happy to help arrange a viewing so you can see it in person.

The layout sounds like it could work for us, and yes, I’d be open to seeing it in person. Could you let me know the current price and monthly maintenance first, including whether a car park is included? Then we can work out whether a viewing makes sense.

For the 900 sq.ft. Type A, maintenance works out to RM162 per month (RM0.18 × 900 sq.ft.), including the sinking fund. Pay-per-use clubhouse charges are separate. The current indicative price is still being confirmed, and I’ll check whether a car park is included for the relevant unit and price configuration rather than assume. Once those details are clear, you can decide whether a viewing makes sense—there’s no commitment to book.
